changelog.en: Flutter rebuild v1.0.4: Pure Live player (MPV/IJK/AVPlayer with auto-fallback ladder), live sources for Bilibili/Douyu/Huya/Douyin/Kuaishou, Infuse-style video, Apple Music-style player with crossfade, Master quality, LX script engine, five play modes, sleep timer, offline download, danmaku, backup/restore, online update. All 24 reported bugs fixed. 498 tests pass.
changelog.tw: Flutter 重構 v1.0.4：Pure Live 播放器（MPV/IJK/AVPlayer 自動切換）、Bilibili/鬥魚/虎牙/抖音/快手直播源、Infuse 風格影視、Apple Music 風格播放器（交叉淡化）、Master 音質、LX 腳本引擎、五種播放模式、睡眠定時、離線下載、彈幕、備份還原、線上更新。24 個回報問題全修。498 個測試通過。
changelog.zh: Flutter重构v1.0.4：Pure Live播放器（MPV/IJK/AVPlayer自动切换）、Bilibili/斗鱼/虎牙/抖音/快手直播源、Infuse风格影视、Apple Music风格播放器（交叉淡化）、Master音质、LX脚本引擎、五种播放模式、睡眠定时、离线下载、弹幕、备份还原、在线更新。24个回报问题全修。498个测试通过。
